units.source_text: 此时日色已暮，急欲入寺礼佛，大家忙着准备明灯。

en.t: By this time the sun had already set, and everyone, eager to enter the temple and worship, hurried to prepare the lamps.

units.source_text: 三人不便再谈，只得暂且分手。

en.t: The three of them could no longer speak conveniently, so they had no choice but to part for the moment.

units.source_text: 右近意欲两家合并，一同入寺。

en.t: Ukon wanted the two parties to join together and enter the temple as one group.

units.source_text: 但恐引起随从人等怀疑，终于作罢。

en.t: But fearing that this would arouse suspicion among the attendants, she finally gave up the idea.

units.source_text: 乳母对丰后介也不泄露消息。

en.t: The nurse did not reveal the news even to Bungo no Suke.

units.source_text: 于是各自分别走出宿处，向长谷寺前进。

en.t: So they each left their lodgings separately and made their way toward Hasedera Temple.

units.source_text: 右近偷偷地察看乳母家一群人，但见其中有一女子，后影非常窈窕，

en.t: Ukon secretly looked over the nurse's party and saw among them one young woman whose figure from behind was extraordinarily graceful,

units.source_text: 举止有些困疲，身披一件初夏单衫，透露出乌油油的黑发来，样子异常美丽。

en.t: her movements somewhat weary, wearing a light early-summer robe through which her glossy black hair showed, and her appearance was exceptionally beautiful.

units.source_text: 她看出这人就是玉鬘，觉得深可怜爱，又不胜悲伤。

en.t: She realized that this person was Tamakazura, and felt both deep tenderness for her and unbearable sorrow.

units.source_text: 善于步行的人，早已到达大殿。

en.t: Those who were good walkers had already reached the main hall.

units.source_text: 乳母一行为了照顾玉鬘，步行甚缓，

en.t: The nurse's party, taking care of Tamakazura, walked very slowly,

units.source_text: 直到初次夜课开始之时，方始到达。

en.t: and only arrived when the first evening service was beginning.

units.source_text: 大殿上非常嘈杂，十方信善拥挤，处处喧哗扰攘。

en.t: The main hall was extremely noisy, crowded with believers from every direction, and everywhere there was clamorous bustle.

units.source_text: 右近的座位设在佛像近旁的右方。

en.t: Ukon's seat had been arranged on the right side near the Buddha image.

units.source_text: 乳母家的人，大约是与法师交情未深之故，其座位设在远离佛像的西边。

en.t: The nurse's household, probably because they were not very close to the priest, had their seats set far from the Buddha image on the western side.

units.source_text: 右近派人去找到了他们，对他们说：“还是迁移到这里来吧。”

en.t: Ukon sent someone to find them and say, "You had better move over here."

units.source_text: 乳母便把情由告知丰后介，叫男子们仍留原处，

en.t: The nurse then explained the situation to Bungo no Suke and told the men to remain where they were,

units.source_text: 带着玉鬘迁移到了右近那边，教她和右近相见。

en.t: while she took Tamakazura over to Ukon's side and had her meet Ukon.

units.source_text: 右近对乳母说：“我身虽然微贱，只因是现今源氏太政大臣家的人，

en.t: Ukon said to the nurse, "Though I myself am of humble standing, because I now belong to the household of Genji, the Grand Minister,

units.source_text: 所以随从即使简单，一路上也无人敢欺，很可放心。

en.t: even with only a simple escort, no one dares insult us along the road, so you may feel quite at ease.

units.source_text: 乡下出来的人，到这等地方来，往往受恶棍强徒侮辱，倒是要当心的。”

en.t: People who come from the countryside to places like this are often mistreated by villains and ruffians, so that is what you must be careful about."

units.source_text: 她还想讲下去，但是僧众已经开始法事，

en.t: She still wanted to go on speaking, but the monks had already begun the service,

units.source_text: 念诵之声鼎沸，她们只得停止谈话，参加礼拜。

en.t: and as the sound of chanting rose like a roar, they had no choice but to stop talking and join in the worship.

units.source_text: 右近向观音菩萨默祷：“多年以来，小女子为欲寻找小姐下落，常向菩萨祈愿。

en.t: Ukon silently prayed to the Bodhisattva Kannon: "For many years, this humble woman has prayed to you, wishing to find my young lady's whereabouts.

units.source_text: 果蒙菩萨呵护，现已找到小姐。

en.t: Thanks indeed to your protection, I have now found my young lady.

units.source_text: 今日复有祈愿：源氏太政大臣寻访小姐，情意深挚。

en.t: Today I have another prayer: Genji, the Grand Minister, has been searching for her with deep and sincere feeling.

units.source_text: 小女子今将奉告大臣。

en.t: I will now inform the Minister of this.

units.source_text: 今后仍望菩萨呵护，赐我小姐终身幸福！”

en.t: From now on, may the Bodhisattva continue to protect her and grant my young lady lifelong happiness!"
